Helle Morphe mit weißer Unterseite, rost: Pale morph with white underparts, rusty-red back and rusty leg feathers. The iris turns brown with age.
Gleiche helle Morphe, häufig erheblich g: Same pale morph, often considerably larger than the male. A rarer dark morph also occurs.
Braunere Oberseite, weißer Bauch und hel: Browner upperparts, white belly and pale legs with brown spots. The iris is yellowish; the tail looks darker than in the adult.
Von einer Warte oder aus dem Flug sucht: From a lookout or on the wing it scans open areas for mammals. It also hunts on the ground and sometimes waits outside a rodent burrow.
Mit breiten Flügeln und mächtigen Fängen: With broad wings and mighty talons it hunts among the treetops of the rainforest.
Große, zusammenhängende tropische Tiefla: Large, unbroken tropical lowland forests with old, tall trees.
Grauer Kopf mit doppelter Federhaube, du: Grey head with a double crest, dark breast band and white belly. The feathered thighs are barred dark; the iris can look grey to brown.
Dasselbe graue, schwarze und weiße Alter: The same grey, black and white adult plumage as the male. The female is considerably larger and heavier; eye colour alone is not a reliable sex characteristic.
Kopf und Unterseite sind weitgehend weiß: Head and underparts are largely white, back and wings pale grey with darker areas. The dark breast band is absent at first; the adult plumage develops over several years.
Die Harpyie wartet oft lange auf einem A: The harpy eagle often waits a long time on a perch, scanning the treetops for sloths or monkeys. With a short, powerful approach it grabs the prey with its huge talons.
Ein mächtiger Segelflieger über Afrikas: A mighty soarer over Africa's savannahs, with a dark breast and a boldly spotted belly.
Offene Savannen, Grasland, lichte Gehölz: Open savannahs, grassland, open woodland and semi-deserts with large trees or other tall nest sites.
Dunkelbrauner Kopf, Hals und obere Brust: Dark brown head, neck and upper breast, topped by a short crest. The white belly and feathered legs are spotted brown; the iris is yellow.
Das Gefieder entspricht dem des Männchen: The plumage matches the male's. Females are considerably larger and can take larger prey on average.
Heller Kopf und weiße, zunächst weitgehe: Pale head and white, initially largely unmarked underparts. The dark breast shield and bold belly spots are absent; the upperparts are paler brown and the iris darker than in the adult.
Der Kampfadler sucht im Segelflug nach g: The martial eagle searches for larger birds and mammals on the ground while soaring. When it spots suitable prey, it seizes it with its powerful talons after a steep stoop.
Gelbe Augen und breite Federohren prägen: Yellow eyes and broad ear tufts mark this powerful owl of the Americas.
Wälder, Feldgehölze, offene Landschaften: Forests, copses, open country and wetlands with suitable perches.
Graubraunes bis bräunliches Gefieder mit: Greyish-brown to brownish plumage with dark barring, a white throat patch and yellow eyes. The colouring varies markedly by region.
Im Gefieder ähnlich wie das Männchen, ge: Similar in plumage to the male, usually larger and heavier. Legs and toes are densely feathered.
Flügge Jungvögel ähneln den Altvögeln, w: Fledged juveniles resemble the adults, at first look softer about the head and have less pronounced ear tufts. The eyes are already yellow.
Von einem Ansitz ortet er kleine Säugeti: From a perch it locates small mammals and birds by sight and hearing. It then approaches in silent flight and seizes the prey with its powerful talons.
Mit gestrecktem Hals und weit ausgebreit: With neck outstretched and wings spread wide, it circles over meadows and floodplains.
Feuchte Wiesen, Weiden, Auen und offene: Wet meadows, pastures, floodplains and open farmland with easily reachable food.
Weißes Gefieder mit schwarzen Schwungfed: White plumage with black flight feathers, long red legs and a red bill. In flight the neck and legs stay outstretched.
Ähnlich gefärbt wie das Männchen, im Mit: Coloured like the male, on average slightly smaller. The sexes can hardly be told apart by plumage.
Flügge Jungstörche tragen bereits weißes: Fledged young storks already have white body plumage. A greyish-brown bill, dull red legs and brownish-tinged dark coverts distinguish them from adults.
Langsam schreitet er über Wiesen oder du: It strides slowly across meadows or through shallow water, searching for small animals. When it spots prey, it strikes precisely with its long bill.
Kurze Flügel und ein langer Schwanz mach: Short wings and a long tail make it an agile hunter of small birds.
Wälder, Waldränder, Hecken, Parks und Gä: Forests, forest edges, hedges, parks and gardens with cover and plenty of small birds.
Blaugraue Oberseite und meist rostorange: Blue-grey upperparts and usually rusty-orange barred underparts. The iris of adult males turns orange to reddish.
Deutlich größer, oberseits grau bis brau: Considerably larger, grey to brownish grey above and white below with greyish-brown barring. A pale supercilium is often prominent; the iris is yellow to pale orange.
Braune Oberseite mit hellen Federsäumen: Brown upperparts with pale feather fringes and irregular brown spots on the pale underparts. The iris is pale yellow at first.
Er nutzt Hecken, Bäume und andere Deckun: It uses hedges, trees and other cover to approach small birds unnoticed. With short wingbeats and tight turns it pursues its prey through the vegetation.
